initial_observation: The first independent check falsely reported paragraph-word changes in all fifteen ordinary notes of naturalistic runs 2 and 3. Their SVG and UTF-8 JSON contained the same words, including a middle-dot year separator.
cause: Path.read_text() used the Windows default text encoding for JSON while ElementTree decoded the XML as UTF-8. The year separator therefore differed in the evaluator's decoded strings.
repair: Read the source JSON explicitly as UTF-8. Keep full paragraph wording, order, type and date-band assertions. Re-evaluate the original untouched agent artifacts.
corrected_observation: Both source contracts pass after the encoding repair, and evaluator-owned browser reruns pass. No Pi output or skill payload was changed by this correction.
retention: The initial evaluator findings are recorded here; the independent-artifact.json files contain the corrected result. Raw Pi events, source documents and images remain in the original run directories.
separate_failure: Run 1 retains its strict failure: a manual visual edit put the stagecoach prose over a duration stem. Its final artifact was corrected and passes the independent contract. That agent failure is not reclassified as an evaluator defect.
